summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 with its official Q8 DSpark drafter for text and image generation. Uses eight draft tokens per step.
note: Validated on gfx1151 with Q4_K_M target weights: text and images, batched HIP graphs, forced rejection, confidence truncation, and allocation plans. Block sizes 1, 4, 8 and 15 are supported; 0 uses the checkpoint default of 15. Block 8 is faster on the measured 1K/8K text prompts; block 4 is faster on the measured coding prompt.
